meanings: To put on a sour, austere, harsh, astringent, stern, grave look; look with frown, wear a grin of pain and anguish, express foolish satisfaction, endure pain, show disappointment, grin with lips, make contracted face and its surrounding parts; stern, severe, forbidding look.

occurrences.verseArabic: تَلْفَحُ وُجُوهَهُمُ النَّارُ وَهُمْ فِيهَا كَالِحُونَ
occurrences.verseTransliteration: Telfehu vucûhehumun nâru ve hum fîhâ kâlihûn(kâlihûne).
occurrences.verseMeaning: Ateş, yüzlerini yalar. Ve onlar da içinde sırıtıp kalacaklar.
